findings: `learner.overview.text` presents the nest-to-west explanation and sound-based borrowing as alternatives, but does not explain that borrowing would mean reusing the sign for a different word because of sound similarity. It also leaves the nest name and sound match unestablished, a limit already supported in the deeper account. Revise the overview to present the whole-graph nest interpretation as disputed, explain the proposed sound-based reuse in plain language, and keep the sunset account qualified as a competing explanation.
